3.4 Photocatalytic tests
Photocatalytic experiments evaluated boron-doped TiO2 catalysts for tetracycline (TC) degradation
under visible and solar light (Fig. 6a). Boron-doped variants,

especially Ov-B2-TiO2, outperformed
both TiO2 and Ov-TiO2. Under visible light (420 nm filter), Ov-B2-TiO2 degraded 90% of TC in 2
hours and 100% in 3 hours (LC-MS analysis), highlighting boron’s role in enhancing TiO2

activity.
First-order kinetics were observed (Fig. S16), with a rate constant of 0.016 min⁻¹ for the best sample,
and stability tests (Fig. 6b) showed consistent performance over five cycles, proving robust

recyclability. Comparative analysis (Fig. 6c) shows that Ov-B-TiO2 shows both a higher degradation
